rationale: Both verify flags/arithmetic rigorously and independently catch the same headroom math error and the TP1-vs-TP2 host-RAM sizing issue. X more directly hits the ground-truth Ref2VA concern (explicitly flags that only FL2VA was validated and reusing the 4-GPU command for Ref2VA risks OOM), while Y's Ref2VA finding is reframed as a missing-prerequisites/download-steps gap rather than an untested-config risk. X also surfaces several additional well-grounded, actionable issues (sync-timeout sizing, PCIe/NUMA device-order rationale, missing alternative configs, missing resident-layer rationale, missing software version) that Y misses, giving it higher recall at comparable precision and actionability; Y's unique contribution (missing numactl prerequisite) is real but narrower in scope.
